name: Petrichloral
summary: Petrichloral (pentaerythritol chloral, brand name Periclor) is a sedative and hypnotic chloral hydrate prodrug. It is a Schedule IV drug in the USA.

pharmacology.text: Petrichloral (pentaerythritol chloral, brand name Periclor) is a sedative and hypnotic chloral hydrate prodrug.

uses.en: It was sold as a sleeping medicine under the name Periclor and is no longer in use.
uses.zh: 它曾以 Periclor 的商品名作為安眠藥販售，現已不再使用。
uses.zhHans: 它曾以 Periclor 的商品名作为安眠药贩售，现已不再使用。

sideEffects.en: It releases chloral hydrate in the body, so the same concerns apply: drowsiness, unsteadiness, stomach upset, a narrow margin before breathing is affected, and dependence with a withdrawal that can include seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 它在體內釋出水合氯醛，因此有相同的顧慮：嗜睡、步態不穩、腸胃不適，距離影響呼吸的用量差距很小，並會造成依賴，戒斷時可能出現癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它在体内发布水合氯醛，因此有相同的顾虑：嗜睡、步态不稳、肠胃不适，距离影响呼吸的用量差距很小，并会造成依赖，戒断时可能出现癫痫发作。

fact.en: It is four chloral units joined to a pentaerythritol core, a design meant to deliver chloral hydrate without its harsh taste and stomach irritation.
fact.zh: 它由四個氯醛單位接在季戊四醇核心上組成，這種設計是為了提供水合氯醛的作用，而避免其刺鼻味道與對胃的刺激。
fact.zhHans: 它由四个氯醛单位接在季戊四醇内核上组成，这种设计是为了提供水合氯醛的作用，而避免其刺鼻味道与对胃的刺激。
